about: Reruns of the committed experiments from a scratch working directory, compared file by file (and CSV row by row) with the committed outputs/, plus the app's default demo. Written by python -m residualmap.checks --compare/--reproduce. The workdir paths are scratch directories of the session that made each entry and do not persist; the comparison results are the record.

pre_edit.code: unchanged tree: git 8090ed8 (residualmap/ and app.py copied aside before any edit and run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the copy)
pre_edit.note: Run by hand from scratch directories with outputs/cache linked to the repo cache, before any edit, Net3 and Net2 in parallel; wall-clock 166 s (Net3), 155 s (structural), 141 s (Net2), 2 s (pilot); return codes were not recorded, but every run printed its final timing line and wrote all its outputs. The structural run first crashed in the fresh directory (FileNotFoundError: experiment.plot_stress reads outputs/structural_persistent/summary_Net3.json before main() writes it); it was rerun after copying the committed summary there, which is what --reproduce does, and the run overwrote that copy at 19:35:23 together with its other outputs. The app's default demo in app_default_demo was run when this entry was written, on the same unchanged copy of the code (code_root).
